name: @starci/ai-router
description: A router for OpenAI-compatible calls across many providers (Anthropic through a protocol adapter, OpenRouter, Qwen, DeepSeek, OpenAI, Gemini, Groq and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), each with an array of keys, behind one virtual key: an OpenAI-compatible gateway with virtual keys, quotas and usage, a NestJS module (AiRouterModule, AiRouterService, AiRouterGatewayModule), and createRouter for plain Node, with health-aware selection, a persisted key blacklist for spent quotas and refused secrets, circuit breakers, rate-limit awareness, failover across providers and models by profile, pinned embeddings, config from env and redacted telemetry.
author: starci183

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}).filter((n) => n.endsWith('.d.ts'))) fs.writeFileSync('dist/' + f, fs.readFileSync('dist/' + f, 'utf8').replace(/((?:from |import\()['\x22]\.\.?\/[^'\x22]+)\.ts(['\x22])/g, (all, head, quote) => head + '.js' + quote))"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="src/**/*.ts" --test-coverage-lines=90 "test/**/*.test.ts"
